prompt_templates.common:
You are reviewing an offline preparation video for a fixed tabletop robot task.
The only task information is the final goal: {instruction}
Use only the supplied frames from this video. Do not claim to have seen a
continuation, a simulator state, or an exact future success probability.
"Satisfied" means a visible condition needed for the final goal appears to
hold, not merely that an object moved. Cite only supplied frame seconds.
If the view cannot resolve object identity, occupancy, or an alternative route,
use "unknown" and say what is missing.
Return exactly one JSON object, no markdown and no per-frame number list.
Keep it compact: cite exactly two evidence entries, one before and one after
the event interval; each supports value must be one short string, not a list.
Use no extra keys and keep every free-text value below 20 words.
Required keys: goal_observed_complete (true/false/unknown as a string), relation
(one concrete goal-relevant visible condition), before_satisfied and
after_satisfied (true/false/unknown strings), comparison
(better/same/worse/unknown string), event_interval_s (two integer seconds 0..14),
evidence (list of objects with second, region, supports), alternative_route,
disconfirming_observation, uncertainty_reason (text or null).
prompt_templates.D: Directly assess whether the observed action made progress toward the final goal, had no supported effect, or hindered it. Fill the event record with visible before/after evidence and any uncertainty.
prompt_templates.P: Choose the single most decisive visible condition that the final goal may require. Describe that condition before and after the observed action using cited frames. Only then compare its contribution to the goal. Mention any other independent blocker you cannot inspect.
prompt_templates.F: Independently compare continuing the final goal from the scene before and after this action. Try to disprove an apparent improvement: could the goal already have been achievable before, or could a blocker remain afterward? Name a concrete alternative route if visible; otherwise say unknown. Base the comparison on cited frames.
prompt_templates.D2_review:
Review the previous direct event record below against the same supplied frames. Correct any visual or logical mistake; preserve uncertainty where evidence is insufficient. Return the same event schema. Previous record (untrusted draft, not extra visual evidence):
{prior}
